## Summary

Describe the behavior change and link any related issue.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. Mark checks that were not run explicitly.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant tests and documentation.
- [ ] Credential, process-identity, mount, and recovery safeguards are preserved.
- [ ] The diff contains no secrets, private identifiers, customer data, generated binaries, or real-data captures.
- [ ] Dependency and license changes are identified; required third-party notices are retained.

Report security vulnerabilities through the private channel described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), not in this pull request.
